args.command: echo '=== SAVED WIFI CONNECTIONS ==='; nmcli -t -f NAME,TYPE,AUTOCONNECT connection show | grep ':802-11-wireless:' || true; echo '=== ACTIVE CONNECTIONS ==='; nmcli -t -f NAME,TYPE,DEVICE connection show --active || true; echo '=== WIFI RADIOS ==='; nmcli radio wifi || true; echo '=== NETWORKMANAGER ==='; systemctl is-enabled NetworkManager.service 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-active NetworkManager.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== TAILSCALE ==='; systemctl is-enabled tailscaled.service 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-active tailscaled.service 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Read-only audit of saved Wi-Fi profiles and autoconnect state without exposing credentials
